fields.why: Beyond the single case, the clinic survey computes its own program measures (vaccination recommendation and administration percentages) and compares them preoutbreak vs postoutbreak and city vs rural; own counts plus comparison is yes.

Single-group results are presented as findings (13 canine cases, 4 died or euthanized, none up to date on vaccination; 100% of responding city clinics recommending more often) alongside the period comparison.
The human case is investigated as part of the canine outbreak; a case report nested in an outbreak investigation is outbreak investigation only.
The only candidate SPD is rural vs city veterinary clinics, i.e. rurality of non-human units, which is not an SPD.
Rurality here describes clinics and dogs' locations, not people's social position; the brief excludes rurality of non-human units.
